comment: What the cosmetic_filtering check expects of /cosmetic/index.html. 'hidden' are ad containers that the pinned EasyList hides on any site ('rule' is the line in overlay/third_party/filter_lists/easylist.txt; tests/test_bench_cosmetic.py checks that it is there). 'visible' are first-party elements, with names that merely look like ad names, that must stay. 'hijack_flag' is a window property that the page's own scripts set if they can intercept the injection: it must stay unset. 'generic_sheet_probe' is a selector that only the generic hide sheet names; the check counts the adopted sheets that hold it and expects one.
